'''MT-7T''' was a public relations [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that worked for the corporation [[Renew]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]], during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. When Renew went bankrupt, the corporation's staff abandoned the world, and as there was only one [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] available for evacuation purposes, the droid was left behind on Korad.
